user.title: Set up Vector
user.description:
Choose one mode only.

Host and Serial are required in all modes because Home Assistant connects directly to the robot on your local network and Serial is used for provisioning and correct robot generation detection.

EscapePod/Wire-pod mode: Fill Robot name, Host, and Serial.

DDL cloud mode: Fill Robot name, Host, Serial, Email, and Password. Email/Password are only used to fetch cloud auth data; the robot connection is still local via Host.

Only fill Email and Password for DDL cloud mode. Leave both empty for EscapePod/Wire-pod mode.
